title: Equivalent fractions and simplest form
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

sections.title: Make an equivalent fraction
sections.objective: Multiply the top and bottom by the same number to get an equal fraction.
explain: Multiplying by {4/4} is multiplying by 1: the pieces get smaller, and there are more of them.
Multiplying only the top, or adding to both, changes the amount.

visual.caption: Cut each third into smaller pieces. The shaded amount stays the same.

sections.key: Multiply the top AND the bottom by the same number. The amount stays the same.

sections.title: Find the missing number
sections.objective: Fill in the box so two fractions are equal.
explain: If the numbers don't fit nicely, simplify the first fraction first.
sections.key: Find what one number was multiplied by, then do the same to the other number.

worked.note: Do the same to the top.

sections.workedCaption: Tap through: find the ×, then copy it.

sections.title: Write a fraction in simplest form
sections.objective: Divide the top and bottom by a common factor until nothing else divides both.
explain: The greatest common factor gets there in one step. A smaller number works too: just keep going.
sections.key: Divide the top and the bottom by the same number until nothing bigger than 1 divides both.

worked.note: Nothing else divides 3 and 4: simplest form.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.objective: Make equivalent fractions, fill in missing numbers, and simplify, mixed together.
explain: Now the problems are mixed. Read what each one asks for.
sections.key: Making an equal fraction: multiply top and bottom. Simplifying: divide top and bottom.

hints.frac.equivalent.scale: Multiply the top by the number, then multiply the bottom by the same number.
hints.frac.equivalent.missing: What do you multiply by to get from one bottom to the other (or one top to the other)? Do the same to the other number.
hints.frac.equivalent.simplify: Find a number that divides both the top and the bottom. Divide both by it, and check whether you can keep going.
hints.frac.equivalent: Read what the problem asks for: an equal fraction, a missing number, or simplest form.

simplifyHint: That's the right amount, but it isn't in simplest form yet. Is there a number that still divides both the top and the bottom?

misconceptionMessages.frac.eq-top-only: Multiply the bottom by the same number too. If only the top changes, the amount changes.
misconceptionMessages.frac.eq-added: Adding the same number to the top and bottom changes the amount. Multiply them by the same number instead.
misconceptionMessages.frac.eq-scaled-back: That's the fraction you started with. The question asks you to multiply the top and bottom, and write the new fraction.
misconceptionMessages.frac.eq-missing-added: Adding the same amount to the top and bottom changes the fraction. Find what you multiply by, and multiply the other number by the same.
misconceptionMessages.frac.eq-divided-top-only: Divide the bottom by the same number too. Simplifying changes both numbers, not the amount.
